mapper.sql: n.id::text,n.goal_id::text,n.condition_round,n.message_type,n.title,n.content,n.read_at,n.handle_status,n.handled_at, n.version,n.created_at,n.updated_at,g.version AS goal_version, COALESCE(n.handle_status='PENDING' AND g.completion_condition_met AND g.completion_round=n.condition_round AND g.status<>'COMPLETED' AND g.archived_at IS NULL AND g.deleted_at IS NULL,false) AS can_handle
FROM notification_message n LEFT JOIN goal g ON g.id=n.goal_id AND g.user_id=n.user_id
mapper.select: SELECT n.id,n.user_id,n.goal_id,n.condition_round,n.message_type,n.title,n.content,n.read_at,n.handle_status,n.handled_at,n.version,n.created_at,n.updated_at FROM notification_message n WHERE n.user_id=#{userId} AND n.id=#{id}
SELECT ORDER BY n.created_at DESC,n.id DESC LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM notification_message WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND read_at IS NULL AND handle_status<>'INVALIDATED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_message(user_id,goal_id,condition_round,message_type,title,content,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{userId},#{goalId},#{conditionRound},'GOAL_COMPLETION_CONFIRM',#{title},#{content},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT(user_id,goal_id,condition_round) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_message SET read_at=#{now},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND read_at IS NULL
UPDATE notification_message SET read_at=#{now},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND read_at IS NULL AND handle_status<>'INVALIDATED'
UPDATE notification_message SET handle_status=#{status},handled_at=#{now},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND handle_status='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT g.id AS goal_id,g.name,g.status,g.archived_at,g.deleted_at,g.completion_condition_met,g.completion_round,g.version, (g.deleted_at IS NULL AND g.archived_at IS NULL AND g.status<>'COMPLETED' AND COALESCE(u.is_enabled,false) AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM identity_user_role ur JOIN identity_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.id AND r.code='USER' AND r.is_enabled AND r.deleted_at IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM identity_user_role ur JOIN identity_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.id AND r.code IN('ADMIN','SUPER_ADMIN') AND r.is_enabled AND r.deleted_at IS NULL) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM stage s JOIN task t ON t.stage_id=s.id AND t.user_id=g.user_id WHERE s.goal_id=g.id AND s.user_id=g.user_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.deleted_at IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM stage s JOIN task t ON t.stage_id=s.id AND t.user_id=g.user_id WHERE s.goal_id=g.id AND s.user_id=g.user_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.status<>'COMPLETED')) AS qualifies FROM goal g LEFT JOIN identity_user u ON u.id=g.user_id WHERE g.user_id=#{userId} AND g.id=#{goalId}
mapper.update: UPDATE goal SET completion_condition_met=#{met},completion_round=#{round},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{goalId} AND version=#{version}

UPDATE notification_message SET handle_status='INVALIDATED',handled_at=#{now},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND goal_id=#{goalId} AND handle_status='PENDING' AND condition_round<>#{keepRound}
UPDATE goal SET completion_condition_met=false,version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND completion_condition_met
UPDATE notification_message SET handle_status='INVALIDATED',handled_at=#{now},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND handle_status='PENDING'
